# Classifieds
[italic]Notices from readers, set as received. The Herald does not vouch for any of it. Inmate families advertise free, and notices from the cells reach us through the warden's office, eventually.[/italic]
## Housing - [bold]BUNK SWAP[/bold], staff quarters. Guard on night rotation seeks a bunk further from the reactor hum. Will trade a week of coffee rations. - Official staff allocations are posted at [netlink="housing assignments" link="colony.seegson.net/housing"].
## Work - [bold]MESS HANDS[/bold] wanted for the inmate mess. Early starts, Company vetting required, hot meal at the end of every shift. - [bold]REACTOR TECHNICIAN[/bold] wanted on contract. Must be willing to work on a unit the last technician described in writing as a knock-off.
## For Sale and Trade - [bold]CASSETTE TAPES[/bold], three, mostly country. Will trade for batteries, or for a chess partner who does not cheat. - [bold]WANTED[/bold]: seed packets for the hydroponics trays. Anything but more tomatoes.
## Lost and Found - [bold]MISSING[/bold]: Harry, a cactus, last seen in engineering. He has been moved again. Whoever has him, water him sparingly and put him back.
## Notices - Pastor Oleksandr leads Baptist readings by the cryo bay every rest day, for staff and for inmates with privileges. He brings the Bible. Bring your own chair. - [bold]VISITING PASSAGE[/bold]: the next transport into Dock A has a few family berths. Book through the warden's office and bring every form twice. - To whoever keeps wedging the Dock B shutters open: the warden blames the inmates, the inmates blame the staff, and we will print the name.
To place a notice, find the Herald's correspondent or leave a comment under any story on the front page.
